prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. New collectible for a cozy Korean mobile aquarium game. STYLE REFERENCE ONLY; do not draw the reference character or reference background. Match the reference's SOFT LUMINOUS FANTASY ILLUSTRATION style: smooth flowing organic shapes, fine softly colored contours, delicate gradients, dimensional painted shading, pearlescent translucent fins and soft refracted glow, magical sophisticated detail. NO chunky dark-brown cartoon outlines, no metallic costume or gold jewelry overload. Reference animal species/purple colors/stars are not required; use turtle and natural CORAL colors. Subject: A graceful fantasy SEA TURTLE with soft mint and ivory skin, flowing translucent peach-pink swimming flippers, a richly detailed domed shell bearing a miniature living coral garden of rose and lilac branches and pearly anemones, elegant small branching CORAL CROWN on its head, big gentle luminous eyes. Shell patterns glow softly like refracted coral light. Natural coral materials, not metallic gold armor, no chains, no jewelry costume. Three-quarter swimming side profile facing LEFT. A square 2x2 animation SPRITE SHEET, four equal square cells, exactly ONE same subject per cell, facing LEFT in all four cells. Four subtle fin and tail swimming phases. Same character size, body center and proportions in all frames. IMPORTANT: each full animal bounding box INCLUDING antennae, crown, coral branches, tail, fins must occupy NO MORE THAN 32% of TOTAL canvas width AND height (64% of its cell). Exact centers: 25%,25%;75%,25%;25%,75%;75%,75%. Broad blank transparent gaps: center vertical band x=43%..57% and horizontal y=43%..57% completely empty; outer 8% border blank. No zoom-in, no grid lines. Four SMALL subjects separated by ample blank space. Genuine ALPHA TRANSPARENT PNG, no checkerboard, black background, scene, rocks, floor, water, bubbles, cast shadow, text, labels, screen UI or watermark. Use thumbnail reference for EXACT animal identity and preserve its grade-specific rendering style.
edge_cleanup_prompt: Edit this 2x2 four-frame turtle sprite sheet for CLEAN TRANSPARENT CUTOUT EDGES. Preserve exact turtle identity, soft mint skin, pastel coral garden and delicate painted fantasy shading INSIDE the turtle. Remove ALL stray disconnected pixels, stippling, dots, sparkles, white flecks, red/yellow flecks, halos and glow outside the turtle silhouette. No particles anywhere outside body and coral branches. Transparent gaps between branches and flippers must be entirely clear. Feathering is limited to a neat 1-pixel antialiased edge: absolutely no white matte, dirty glow or pixel dust. Use a thin smooth pastel-colored contour to define the clean silhouette; NOT thick brown cartoon outlines. Keep highlights and soft gradient detail confined inside the animal. Keep four complete identical-sized turtle poses in equal 2x2 cells. Make animals smaller if necessary to keep outer 8% and central horizontal/vertical 12% bands completely empty. No cropping, changing pose or position. Output genuine transparent RGBA PNG. Do not introduce background checkerboard, scenery, text, drop shadows, water, rocks or any background color.
